title: B. Save the world? Save the cat!

legend: Oh no! Amy the pink cat is stuck in a time loop! To save her, Rover the black cat has to make a journey to The Origin to defeat Aleph-1 the evil cat!

Define a multiverse as a network of n$$$n$$$ universes numbered from 1$$$1$$$ to n$$$n$$$, with The Origin located at node 1$$$1$$$. These universes are connected by a set of n−1$$$n-1$$$ undirected tunnels, each taking wi$$$w_{i}$$$ time to traverse. It is guarantee that all universes belongs to the same component (in other words, a multiverse is a tree).

At the start of his journey, Rover can choose to teleport to any universe s$$$s$$$. Define di$$$d_{i}$$$ as the number of tunnel Rover has to traverse from universe i$$$i$$$ to get to The Origin. At any point during his journey, if Rover is in universe v≠1$$$v\neq1$$$, he can perform a Super Jump and teleport to any universe u$$$u$$$ such that du=dv$$$d_{u} = d_{v}$$$. Super Jump cost no time and can only be performed once during the entire journey.

Unfortunately, Rover the black cat is not good at math. Therefore, he asked you to find the minimum time needed to traverse from universe s$$$s$$$ to The Origin satisfying the given constraint for every starting universe s$$$s$$$ from 1$$$1$$$ to n$$$n$$$.
input: Each test consists of multiple test cases. The first line contains an integer t (1≤t≤103$$$1\leq t\leq 10^{3}$$$) — the number of test cases. Then follows the description of the test cases.
The first line of each test case contains a single integer n$$$n$$$ (2≤n≤5⋅105$$$2\leq n\leq5 \cdot 10^{5}$$$), denoting the number of universes.

Each of the following n−1$$$n-1$$$ lines contains three integers vi$$$v_{i}$$$, ui$$$u_{i}$$$, wi$$$w_{i}$$$ (1≤ui,vi≤n,1≤wi≤109$$$1 \leq u_{i}, v_{i} \leq n, 1 \leq w_{i} \leq 10^{9}$$$), denoting the endpoints and the time needed to traverse the tunnel. It's guaranteed that all universes are connected via tunnels.
output: For each testcases, print n$$$n$$$ integer t1,t2,…,tn$$$t_{1},t_{2},\ldots,t_{n}$$$, denoting the minimum time taken to get from universe i$$$i$$$ to The Origin if Rover starts his journey at universe i$$$i$$$.
note: If Rover starts in universe 2$$$2$$$, it is optimal to perform a Super Jump from universe 2$$$2$$$ to universe 3$$$3$$$.
if Rover starts in universe 3$$$3$$$, it is optimal to perform a Super Jump from universe 2$$$2$$$ to universe 4$$$4$$$.
If Rover starts in universe 5$$$5$$$, it is optimal to perform a Super Jump from universe 5$$$5$$$ to universe 3$$$3$$$.

legend.ai: 哦不！粉色猫咪 Amy 陷入了时间循环！为了拯救她，黑猫 Rover 必须前往起源之地，击败邪恶猫咪 Aleph-1！
定义一个多元宇宙为由 n$$$n$$$ 个编号从 1$$$1$$$ 到 n$$$n$$$ 的宇宙组成的网络，其中起源之地位于节点 1$$$1$$$。这些宇宙由 n−1$$$n-1$$$ 条无向隧道连接，每条隧道需要 wi$$$w_{i}$$$ 时间通过。保证所有宇宙都属于同一个连通分量(换句话说，多元宇宙是一棵树)。

旅程开始时，Rover 可以选择传送到任意宇宙 s$$$s$$$。定义 di$$$d_{i}$$$ 为 Rover 从宇宙 i$$$i$$$ 前往起源之地需要经过的隧道数量。在旅程中的任何时刻，如果 Rover 位于宇宙 v≠1$$$v\neq1$$$，他可以使用超级跳跃，传送到任意一个满足 du=dv$$$d_{u} = d_{v}$$$ 的宇宙 u$$$u$$$。超级跳跃不耗费时间，且整个旅程中只能使用一次。
不幸的是，黑猫 Rover 不擅长数学。因此，他请你求出：对于每个起始宇宙 s$$$s$$$(从 1$$$1$$$ 到 n$$$n$$$)，满足给定约束的情况下，从宇宙 s$$$s$$$ 前往起源之地所需的最短时间。

input.ai: 每个输入包含多个测试用例。第一行包含一个整数 t(1≤t≤103$$$1\leq t\leq 10^{3}$$$)——测试用例的数量。接下来是各个测试用例的描述。
每个测试用例的第一行包含一个整数 n$$$n$$$(2≤n≤5⋅105$$$2\leq n\leq5 \cdot 10^{5}$$$)，表示宇宙的数量。
接下来的 n−1$$$n-1$$$ 行中，每行包含三个整数 vi$$$v_{i}$$$、ui$$$u_{i}$$$、wi$$$w_{i}$$$(1≤ui,vi≤n，1≤wi≤109$$$1 \leq u_{i}, v_{i} \leq n, 1 \leq w_{i} \leq 10^{9}$$$)，表示隧道的两个端点以及穿越该隧道所需的时间。保证所有宇宙都通过隧道彼此连通。

output.ai: 对于每个测试用例，输出 n$$$n$$$ 个整数 t1,t2,…,tn$$$t_{1},t_{2},\ldots,t_{n}$$$，其中第 i 个整数表示如果 Rover 从宇宙 i$$$i$$$ 出发，从宇宙 i$$$i$$$ 到达 The Origin 所需的最短时间。

note.ai: 如果 Rover 从宇宙 2$$$2$$$ 出发，那么从宇宙 2$$$2$$$ 进行一次超级跳跃到宇宙 3$$$3$$$ 是最优的。
如果 Rover 从宇宙 3$$$3$$$ 开始，那么从宇宙 2$$$2$$$ 跳至宇宙 4$$$4$$$ 执行一次超级跳跃是最优的。
如果 Rover 从宇宙 5$$$5$$$ 开始，那么从宇宙 5$$$5$$$ 跳至宇宙 3$$$3$$$ 执行一次超级跳跃是最优的。
